mainBlueprint:
---
schemaVersion: 1
blueprintId: team.u8-main
revision: "1"
leader:
  templateId: leader
  persona: "You are the leader of the u8 vertical team. U8LEADER_PERSONA_2026-09-24T14-48-13"
  capabilities:
    teamTools:
      kind: allow
      items:
        - team_list_members
        - team_list_templates
        - team_inspect_config
        - team_create_member
        - team_delegate
        - team_follow_up
        - team_collect
        - team_send_message
        - team_report_progress
        - team_request_control
        - team_resolve_control
        - team_list_pending_control
        - team_archive_member
    builtinToolDeny:
        - ask_user_question
        - create_goal
        - exit_plan_mode
        - get_goal
        - glob
        - grep
        - interrupt_agent
        - job_kill
        - job_list
        - job_output
        - list_agents
        - present
        - send_message
        - skill
        - subagent_fork
        - update_goal
        - web_fetch
        - web_search
        - workflow
    skills:
      kind: allow
      items: []
    mcp:
      kind: allow
      items:
        - u8single
        - u8paged
        - u8none
    permissions:
      default: ask
      allow:
        - tool: read
          resource:
            kind: subtree
            path: team
      ask:
        - tool: bash
          resource:
            kind: any
      deny:
        - tool: read
          resource:
            kind: subtree
            path: runtime
teamEnvelope:
  allow:
    - assign-task
    - create-member
    - send-message
    - report-progress
    - request-control
    - resolve-control
    - archive-member
    - restore-member
  deny: []
members:

    displayName: "Worker B"
    persona: "You are worker-b of the u8 vertical team. U8WORKER_PERSONA_2026-09-24T14-48-13"
    capabilities:
      teamTools:
        kind: allow
        items:
          - team_send_message
          - team_report_progress
      builtinToolDeny:
          - ask_user_question
          - create_goal
          - exit_plan_mode
          - get_goal
          - glob
          - grep
          - interrupt_agent
          - job_kill
          - job_list
          - job_output
          - list_agents
          - present
          - send_message
          - skill
          - subagent_fork
          - update_goal
          - web_fetch
          - web_search
          - workflow
      skills:
        kind: allow
        items: []
      mcp:
        kind: allow
        items:
          - u8single
          - u8paged
          - u8none
      permissions:
        default: ask
        allow:
          - tool: read
            resource:
              kind: subtree
              path: team
        ask:
          - tool: bash
            resource:
              kind: any
        deny:
          - tool: read
            resource:
              kind: subtree
              path: runtime

      allow:
